character_notes: A curious little otter, about seven in spirit. Bright, wondering, thinks out loud.

speaker: pip
text: Four sand eels! Someone hungry would love these.
character_notes: A curious little otter, about seven in spirit. Bright, wondering, thinks out loud.

speaker: pip
text: What an adventure! Goodnight, island. Goodnight, Puffin Isle!
character_notes: A curious little otter, about seven in spirit. Bright, wondering, thinks out loud.

speaker: owl
text: Hoo! Good morning, Pip. Today is a very special day.
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: Look out to sea. Can you see Puffin Isle?
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: Captain Puff is waiting in Seagrass Cove. Go through Digby's tunnel and find him on the dock!
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: Captain Puff is waiting on the dock in Seagrass Cove.
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: On Puffin Isle there's a grandma puffin called Nana Puff. I think she needs some help.
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: Nana Puff's pufflings are still hungry.
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: There's a little puffin on Puffin Isle called Pebble. He loves to play!
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: Pebble is still waiting for you to find him.
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: Hoo hoo! You sailed all the way to Puffin Isle, Pip!
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: You fed the pufflings and played hide and seek with Pebble.
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: owl
text: What a brave little otter. Sweet dreams!
character_notes: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

speaker: puffin
text: Ahoy, Pip! Our boat is ready.
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: Walk to the end of the dock and hop aboard. Off we go!
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: Walk to the end of the dock and hop aboard!
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: Land ho! Welcome to Puffin Isle, Pip!
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: This is where all the puffins live.
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: My friend Nana Puff lives at the top of the hill, behind the red door. Go and say hello!
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: Have you met little Pebble? He's up by Nana Puff's door.
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: Nana Puff is at the top of the hill, by the red door.
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: Pebble is hiding somewhere. Look carefully for a little wiggle!
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: Ahoy again, Pip!
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: When you want to sail home, hop back in the boat.
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: Pip, you've helped everyone on Puffin Isle!
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: puffin
text: The sun is going down. Let's sail home for the picnic!
character_notes: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

speaker: nana
text: Hello, dearie! I'm Nana Puff.
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: My pufflings are hungry, and my old wings are too tired to go fishing.
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: Could you catch 4 sand eels for them? They jump in the shallow water by the beach.
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: You caught one already! Could you find the rest?
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: You caught two already! Could you find the rest?
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: You caught three already! Could you find the rest?
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: Look for the ripples, dearie, and wait there. When an eel jumps, catch it!
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: My pufflings are still hungry. Wait by the ripples, and catch an eel when it jumps!
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: You have one sand eel. Just a few more, dearie!
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: You have two sand eels. Just a few more, dearie!
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: You have three sand eels. Just a few more, dearie!
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: Four sand eels! Oh, thank you, dearie.
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: Come out, little ones. Breakfast time!
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: Listen to them munching! They'll be big and strong in no time.
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: nana
text: Now go and tell Captain Puff, dearie. It's time to sail home.
character_notes: A kind old grandma puffin. Calls Pip "dearie". Slow and warm.

speaker: pebble
text: Hi! I'm Pebble! Do you want to play hide and seek?
character_notes: A tiny puffling. Giggly, bouncy, loves hide and seek.

speaker: pebble
text: I'll hide, and you find me. Ready? Close your eyes!
character_notes: A tiny puffling. Giggly, bouncy, loves hide and seek.

speaker: pebble
text: Hee hee! You found me! Let's play again!
character_notes: A tiny puffling. Giggly, bouncy, loves hide and seek.

speaker: pebble
text: Found me again! One more time!
character_notes: A tiny puffling. Giggly, bouncy, loves hide and seek.

speaker: pebble
text: You found me three times! You're the best at hide and seek!
character_notes: A tiny puffling. Giggly, bouncy, loves hide and seek.

speaker: pebble
text: That was so much fun! Let's play again next time!
character_notes: A tiny puffling. Giggly, bouncy, loves hide and seek.

speaker: pebble
text: Now go and tell Captain Puff. It's time to sail home!
character_notes: A tiny puffling. Giggly, bouncy, loves hide and seek.

speaker: duck
text: Quack! Have a lovely boat trip, Pip! Wave to the puffins for us.
character_notes: Fussy, loving, a little breathless. Quacky.

speaker: hog
text: A boat trip! I packed a blueberry muffin for your journey.
character_notes: Sweet, small, homey baker. Soft and cheerful.

speaker: crab
text: Click, click! Puffin Isle? Say hello to the sea for me.
character_notes: Creaky, grumbly-kind grandpa. Says "click, click".

speaker: mole
text: My tunnel goes all the way to the cove now. Have a wonderful trip!
character_notes: Excitable, earthy, a bit near-sighted. Talks fast when happy.

speaker: mouse
text: I'm going to write a song about your adventure, Pip!
character_notes: Tiny, musical, sing-song. Hums between words.

speaker: seal
text: Captain Puff's boat is ready! I'll wave to you from the water.
character_notes: A baby seal pup. Shy, then delighted. Very young.

speaker: mouse
text: Your turn! Walk to the crystals in the same order.
character_notes: Tiny, musical, sing-song. Hums between words.

speaker: mouse
text: Yes! You did it! Ready for the next one? Listen!
character_notes: Tiny, musical, sing-song. Hums between words.

speaker: mouse
text: Oops! That's okay. Listen again.
character_notes: Tiny, musical, sing-song. Hums between words.
